title: #IUIC #Bishop #Nathanyel7 #IsraelUnitedInChrist
segments: Here are three important facts about
black history that you need to know.
Pope Nicholas V, a Roman Catholic pope,
is a hat that looks very similar to the
hats used in the Klux Clan still used
today in countries like Spain and Italy.
So the same people that wanted us in
slavery is the same ones today that want
us to call the Pope Holy Father. Matthew
chapter 23 and:9 says, "And call no man
your father upon the earth, for one man
is your father which is in heaven." So
in regards to Black History Month,
should you be a Roman Catholic? No.
